gaunt, narrow-pelvis build with ribcage projecting forward and long thin limbs

distinguishing_features: Q07/Q12 have wide, deep, rectangular trunks with no waist and thick columnar limbs: mass spread evenly from chest to legs. Q08/Q10 are the opposite: a forward-bulging ribcage over a pinched waist and narrow pelvis, long thin limbs with knobby knees and elbows, long low-hanging hands and a slightly bent-knee profile. Q12 is the weakest call and could be an obese human instead (B, bulk).
